title: Why Your Shower Knob Has No Middle Ground
caption:
One tiny turn and your shower turns into lava or ice.
A stick figure nudges the shower knob a hair, then gets blasted from scalding hot to a full-on iceberg bath.
Blame valve sensitivity: a micro-turn spikes the hot-to-cold ratio, so the mix swings wildly in seconds.
Does your shower have a sweet spot, or is it always lava or iceberg?
Save this for your next battle with the knob.
